name: KSeF
description: Polish market 🇵🇱: e-invoicing via the national KSeF 2.0 API — browse incoming cost invoices and your sales, issue FA(3) invoices without leaving the app, track payments. Includes a one-time history import from Fakturownia.pl (numbers, payment statuses, KSeF ids).
author: Cyber Life community

widgets.title: KSeF Today
widgets.description: Invoices that arrived in KSeF today

agentTools.name: list_companies
agentTools.description: List configured companies (id, name, NIP, KSeF environment, last sync time)

agentTools.name: list_invoices
agentTools.description: List invoices across KSeF and imported Fakturownia history. Filter by company, direction (sale/cost), unpaid, date range or free-text query.

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

query.description: Substring match on number, KSeF number or contractor

agentTools.name: create_invoice
agentTools.description: Create a sales invoice (VAT or proforma) with Fakturownia-style numbering; optionally send it straight to KSeF (send: true).

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

send.description: Send to KSeF immediately after creating

agentTools.name: send_invoice
agentTools.description: Send a locally created draft invoice to KSeF (returns the assigned KSeF number)

agentTools.name: mark_paid
agentTools.description: Mark an invoice as paid (or unpaid with paid: false)

agentTools.name: sync
agentTools.description: Fetch new invoices from KSeF (sales and incoming costs) for one or all companies

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; omit for all

agentTools.name: list_unmatched_files
agentTools.description: List archived invoice files (PDF scans) not yet paired with any invoice record

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

agentTools.name: attach_file
agentTools.description: Pair an archived invoice file with an invoice: pass invoiceId to link to an existing record, or createInvoice {dir, number, issueDate, sellerNip, sellerName, net, vat, gross, currency, paid} to create a new record from the document and link it.

matchedBy.description: Short note on how the pairing was decided

gross.description: Gross total in the document currency

vatRate.description: 23/8/5/0, or "zw"/"np"/"disabled"; defaults to the rate read from the document

currency.description: Defaults to the currency read from the document

agentTools.name: import_fakturownia
agentTools.description: Run the full Fakturownia.pl history import for a company (idempotent, re-runnable)

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured
